summary: SAP ECC (ERP Central Component) is SAP's core on-premise ERP — the R/3 successor and predecessor to SAP S/4HANA. It runs application modules on the SAP NetWeaver (ABAP) stack over a relational database. Business content is organised into an enterprise (organisational) structure, master data, transaction data, and configuration (IMG).
successor: SAP S/4HANA (runs on the in-memory HANA database; consolidates customer & vendor masters into the Business Partner, transaction BP).

dataCategories.note: Defines org structure, account groups, number ranges, pricing, etc.
Long-living reference data: customer, vendor, material, GL accounts. Created once, reused across documents.
Business documents: sales orders, deliveries, billing, purchase orders, goods movements, accounting documents.

enterpriseStructure.desc: Highest level; an independent dataset (e.g. 100). Master/transaction data is client-specific.
Smallest unit for which a complete set of legal financial statements is produced. Example in scope: 2100.
Org unit for cost accounting; can span multiple company codes.
Optional unit for internal segment reporting across company codes.
Specifies and controls customer credit limits.
Responsible for selling and distributing goods/services. Example in scope: Z210.
Means by which products reach customers (e.g. wholesale, retail).
Combination of Sales Organization + Distribution Channel + Division. The key that ties customer sales data together.
Geographic / responsibility subdivisions of a sales area.
Manufacturing or distribution location; central org unit in logistics.
Subdivision of a plant where stock is physically kept.
Procures materials/services and negotiates with vendors.

modules.name: Financial Accounting
modules.covers: General Ledger (G/L), Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), Asset Accounting (AA), Bank Accounting. External/legal reporting.

modules.name: Controlling
modules.covers: Cost Element/Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA). Internal management reporting.

modules.name: Sales & Distribution
modules.covers: Order-to-Cash: customer master, inquiries/quotations, sales orders, pricing, deliveries, billing, credit management.

modules.name: Materials Management
modules.covers: Procure-to-Pay: material master, vendor master, purchase requisitions/orders, goods receipt, inventory, invoice verification.

modules.name: Production Planning
modules.covers: BOMs, routings, work centers, MRP, planned and production orders, capacity planning.

modules.name: Quality Management
modules.covers: Inspection lots, quality notifications, certificates, quality in procurement/production.

modules.name: Plant Maintenance
modules.covers: Equipment, functional locations, maintenance orders and notifications.

modules.name: Human Capital Management
modules.covers: Personnel administration, org management, payroll, time.

modules.name: Project System
modules.covers: WBS, networks, project costing and scheduling.

endToEndProcesses.name: Order-to-Cash (OTC)
endToEndProcesses.flow: Customer master → Sales Order (VA01) → Delivery (VL01N) → Goods Issue → Billing (VF01) → Accounting/AR posting → Incoming Payment (F-28).

endToEndProcesses.name: Procure-to-Pay (PTP)
endToEndProcesses.flow: Material & Vendor master → Purchase Requisition → Purchase Order (ME21N) → Goods Receipt (MIGO) → Invoice Verification (MIRO) → Outgoing Payment (F-53).

endToEndProcesses.name: Record-to-Report (RTR)
endToEndProcesses.flow: Journal postings → period-end closing → reconciliation → financial statements.

endToEndProcesses.name: Plan-to-Produce
endToEndProcesses.flow: BOM/Routing → MRP run (MD01) → Production Order (CO01) → Confirmation → Goods Receipt of finished goods.
